title: Foldable Canvas Laundry and Storage Bag
body_html:
Keep laundry, toys and everyday household items together in a foldable canvas storage bag. The cylindrical bag has carrying handles and a zipped top, and folds down for storage when empty.

  • Flexible canvas body for household storage.
  • Handles for carrying the bag.
  • Collapsible design and zipped top.

Wipe with a damp cloth and allow it to air dry. Avoid harsh cleaners and machine washing. Patterns shown are examples; confirm the supplied design before ordering.

title: Manual Citrus Juicer with Strainer
body_html:
Juice citrus fruit by hand with this compact bowl-style juicer. The central reamer presses the fruit, while the removable strainer separates seeds and larger pieces of pulp.

  • Manual operation, with no electrical connection.
  • Plastic bowl with a pouring spout and side handle.
  • Removable strainer for access when cleaning.

Rinse the removable parts after use and allow them to dry before storing.

title: Stainless Steel Water Bottle — Approx. 360 ml
body_html:
A stainless steel water bottle with an approximate 360 ml capacity and a cylindrical design for everyday use.

Clean with mild dishwashing liquid and a bottle brush, rinse thoroughly and allow to dry. Check the lid is securely closed before carrying.

title: Electric Hair Straightening Brush
body_html:
An electric straightening brush with a bristled styling head and handle-mounted temperature adjustment buttons.

Follow the instructions supplied with the appliance when choosing a heat setting. Unplug and allow the brush to cool fully before cleaning, then wipe with a soft cloth. Store in a dry place.

title: Two-Tier Kitchen Storage Rack
body_html:
Arrange jars, bottles and other everyday kitchen items on two raised shelves. The freestanding rack adds storage levels above a counter or shelf.

Place on a level surface and keep items evenly distributed. Storage items shown in the photos are for illustration.

title: Keyboard Cover
body_html:
A keyboard cover for placing over the keys of a compatible keyboard.

Check the shape and key layout against your keyboard before choosing this cover. The keyboard pictured is for illustration and is not included.

title: Structured Mesh Laundry Wash Bag
body_html:
A cylindrical mesh-and-fabric laundry bag with a zip closure for separating suitable small garments in a wash load. Mesh panels allow water to circulate.

What is included

1 laundry wash bag. Garments and washing machine are not included.

Care and checks

Follow each garment and machine care label. Close the zip and avoid overfilling. This bag does not make hand-wash-only garments machine-safe or guarantee protection from damage.

Supplier images are illustrative. Confirm the exact colour and packed contents before ordering. Ordering is not available yet while supplier fulfilment and samples are verified.

title: Household Wiping Cloths — Set of 3
body_html:
Three fabric wiping cloths with a textured terry-style surface and finished edges. Keep separate cloths for accessible glass and suitable kitchen surfaces.

What is included

3 wiping cloths. Colours and patterns may vary.

Care and checks

Wash before first use and between tasks. Test on delicate surfaces. No scratch-free, streak-free or antibacterial performance guarantee is made.

Supplier images are illustrative. Confirm the exact colour and packed contents before ordering. Ordering is not available yet while supplier fulfilment and samples are verified.

title: Adhesive Cable Organizer Clips — Set of 20
body_html:
A set of plastic clips for routing compatible everyday cables on a clean, smooth surface. Adhesive backing provides an installation option without drilling.

What is included

20 cable organizer clips. Cables and electronic devices are not included.

Care and checks

Check surface suitability and cable fit. Avoid rough, wet, dusty or delicate painted surfaces; adhesive can mark a finish. Do not support heavy loads or place near heat sources.

Supplier images are illustrative. Confirm the exact colour and packed contents before ordering. Ordering is not available yet while supplier fulfilment and samples are verified.

title: 3-in-1 Bottle Lid Cleaning Tool
body_html:
A compact hand cleaning tool combining a brush, narrow-opening brush and crevice hook. Useful for accessible lid grooves and small gaps on suitable drinkware.

What is included

1 multifunctional cleaning tool. Bottles and cups are not included.

Care and checks

Use gently and test on a hidden area first. Do not assume sterilisation or infant-feeding safety from cleaning alone. Rinse and air-dry; follow the drinkware maker’s cleaning guidance.

Supplier images are illustrative. Confirm the exact colour and packed contents before ordering. Ordering is not available yet while supplier fulfilment and samples are verified.

title: Flexible Flower-Shaped Drain Catcher
body_html:
A flexible flower-shaped silicone drain cover with perforations and a centre lifting knob. Designed to collect loose hair or scraps over a compatible drain.

What is included

1 drain catcher. Sink and cleaning props are not included.

Care and checks

Measure the drain and surrounding surface before use. Empty and rinse regularly. This is a debris catcher, not a watertight plug or a guarantee against plumbing blockages.

Supplier images are illustrative. Confirm the exact colour and packed contents before ordering. Ordering is not available yet while supplier fulfilment and samples are verified.

title: Foldable Hanging Travel Organizer
body_html:
A foldable travel organizer with multiple pockets and a hanging hook. Packs into a rectangular pouch and opens to keep personal items separated.

What is included

1 organizer bag. Toiletries, bottles, mirror and other display props are not included.

Care and checks

Wipe clean with a damp cloth and air-dry. Do not assume waterproof storage, leak containment or a tested load limit. Check hook and zip quality before use.

Supplier images are illustrative. Confirm the exact colour and packed contents before ordering. Ordering is not available yet while supplier fulfilment and samples are verified.

title: Handheld Upholstery Cleaning Brush
body_html:
A handled manual brush with long bristles for accessible upholstery, mats and suitable household surfaces. Includes a hanging hole for storage.

What is included

1 handheld cleaning brush. Car, upholstery and other display props are not included.

Care and checks

Test on an inconspicuous area before use. Avoid delicate surfaces and fragile fabric. Shake off loose debris, rinse with mild soap if needed and air-dry fully. No damage-free or deep-cleaning guarantee is made.

Supplier images are illustrative. Confirm the exact colour and packed contents before ordering. Ordering is not available yet while supplier fulfilment and samples are verified.

title: Window Groove Cleaning Brush
body_html:
A slim handheld brush for accessible window grooves, sliding-door tracks and other small gaps. The supplier describes a polypropylene handle and bristles.

What is included

1 window-groove cleaning brush. Cleaning liquids are not included.

Care and checks

Check the groove width and test bristles on a hidden area first. Do not assume scratchproof cleaning or use on delicate finishes. Rinse and air-dry after use.

Supplier images are illustrative. Confirm the exact colour and packed contents before ordering. Ordering is not available yet while supplier fulfilment and samples are verified.

title: Compact Cable Winder Case
body_html:
A compact plastic case with a rotating spool for winding a suitable cable. Helps keep a cable together in a desk drawer or travel bag.

What is included

1 cable organizer case. Cable, phone and other display props are not included.

Care and checks

Check cable and connector fit before winding; do not force connectors or bend cables sharply. This is a storage case, not a charger or powered device.

Supplier images are illustrative. Confirm the exact colour and packed contents before ordering. Ordering is not available yet while supplier fulfilment and samples are verified.

title: Reusable Bag Locking Ties — Set of 3
body_html:
Three flexible locking ties for gathering opened packets or bundling small cords. The supplier describes a button-lock design.

What is included

3 locking ties. Packets and cables pictured are not included.

Care and checks

Do not assume an airtight or leakproof seal. Keep small items away from children. Wash with mild detergent and dry before reuse.

Supplier images are illustrative. Confirm the exact colour and packed contents before ordering. Ordering is not available yet while supplier fulfilment and samples are verified.

title: Microfiber Cleaning Cloth — 40 × 40 cm
body_html:
A reusable microfiber cloth for everyday wiping around the home. The supplier lists a 40 × 40 cm size.

What is included

1 cleaning cloth. Colour supplied may vary.

Care and checks

Wash with mild detergent; avoid bleach and fabric softener. Test on an inconspicuous area before using on a delicate finish. Performance has not been independently tested.

Supplier images are illustrative. Confirm the exact colour and packed contents before ordering. Ordering is not available yet while supplier fulfilment and samples are verified.

title: 2-in-1 Soap Dispensing Cleaning Brush
body_html:
Keep soap and scrubbing together. This compact brush combines firm bristles with a refillable liquid holder for sink and surface cleaning.

  • Built-in liquid dispenser.
  • Push mechanism releases cleaning liquid.
  • Compact grip for everyday use.

Includes one brush. Cleaning liquid is not included. Test on a discreet area before use and avoid delicate surfaces.

title: Everyday Travel Organizer Pouch
body_html:
Keep the small things together on days away. A lightweight zippered pouch for organizing everyday travel essentials inside a larger bag.

  • Zipper closure keeps contents together.
  • Lightweight, compact storage.
  • Useful for toiletries, accessories or cables.

Includes one organizer pouch. Accessories shown are for illustration. Colour and design may vary with the supplied assortment.

title: 5-in-1 Rechargeable Cleaning Brush
body_html:
A compact cordless brush for everyday cleaning around sinks, tiles and bathroom surfaces. The interchangeable heads help you switch between cleaning tasks.

  • Rechargeable handheld design.
  • Five-in-one cleaning set.
  • Suitable for kitchen and bathroom routines.

Care

Choose a head suited to the surface and test a discreet area first. Keep the charging connection dry. Follow the included instructions.

title: USB Rechargeable Fabric Shaver
body_html:
Give everyday fabrics a tidy finish. This compact rechargeable shaver removes surface lint and pilling from garments and upholstery.

  • USB rechargeable for cordless use.
  • Handheld design with a protective shaving surface.
  • Cleaning brush included for routine maintenance.

Care

Test a small hidden area first. Keep fabric flat, use light pressure and avoid loose threads or damaged fabric. Switch off before cleaning.
